literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-Origen the on first-principles, treatises four, of-which the first on father, son, holy spirit; in which most he-blasphemes, the son by the father to-have-been-made saying, the spirit by the son, and to-pervade the father through all beings, the son unto rational only, the spirit unto only the being-saved. He-says also other most-perverse and of-impiety full; transmigrations drivels, ensouled stars, other like these. First by-him mythologized on father and (as he says) on Christ and on holy spirit, further on rational natures; second on world and creatures therein, and that one god of-law and prophets, same of-old and new testament god, incarnation of saviour, same spirit in Moses, other prophets, holy apostles; further soul, resurrection, punishment, promises. Third on free-will: how devil and opposing powers according-to scriptures campaign-against the human race; created the world and perishable from time begun. Fourth on end: divine the scriptures. Finally how one-must read and understand the scriptures.
source_text: Codex 8 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 3-4; closeout-4b transcription)
